Hi Priya — thanks for sending these over and for the call this morning. I uploaded the workbook and W-9 to our intake tracker and looped Monica (AP ops) to confirm routing. A few follow-ups so we can get a vendor master record created: 

1) Can you confirm the legal entity exactly as it appears on your articles of incorporation? We want the punctuation/capitalization to match.
2) Who will be the authorized signer for the vendor profile (name + title + email)? We need that for our vendor acceptance audit.
3) Do you have a copy of your IRS EIN verification letter (CP565) or a bank account verification for ACH onboarding? If not, a bank letter is fine.
4) For e-invoicing, our NetSuite integration takes either an emailed PDF or an automated EDI 810. If you want Peppol, we need the endpoint ID. Which is your preference?

Next steps from our side: I will create the vendor record in our test NetSuite instance and send a DocuSign for ACH/ACH waiver (if applicable). Once Monica confirms banking, we will provide the PO channel and vendor ID.

Can you get items 1–3 to me by EOD Wednesday (17 Sep)? If timeline is tight we can accept interim attestations.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
